name: gauntlet
description: Build a production-grade app with an AI agent, review each change, then harden it before launch. Three independent commands: /gauntlet:build turns a plain-English idea into ~16 numbered build prompts with verifiable checkpoints. /gauntlet:review runs a diff-scoped multi-agent code review with adversarial verification (expensive - spawns many subagents). /gauntlet:harden runs the A-G pre-launch audit cascade. Run any one on its own. Includes the 144-item web rubric, 162-item mobile rubric, a CLI primer for non-developers, and a worked example. Every gate is proven able to fail before it is trusted.

interface.shortDescription: Build, review, and harden a production app
interface.longDescription: Three independent skills. $build turns a plain-English idea into ~16 numbered build prompts, each ending in a checkpoint you can verify. $review runs a diff-scoped multi-agent code review where every finding is adversarially refuted before it is reported (expensive - see the skill's cost section). $harden runs the A-G pre-launch audit cascade. Includes the full 144-item web rubric, the 162-item mobile rubric, a terminal/CLI primer for non-developers, and a worked example. Every gate ships with a canary proving it can fail.
defaultPrompt: Use build to turn my app idea into a sequence of build prompts with checkpoints.
Use harden to run Phase A of the pre-launch audit on this project.
Use review to review my current branch, scaled to the size of the diff.
